name: pairip_jni_on_load
func_comment: JNI_OnLoad root. Early native initialization path that installs runtime state, builds native registration metadata, and reaches pairip_jni_execute_vm_bridge through the registration chain before Java-side business entrypoints run.

name: pairip_jni_execute_vm_bridge
func_comment: High-confidence JNI bridge for VMRunner.executeVM(byte[] vmCode, Object[] args). Observed shape: reads jbyteArray length through JNIEnv, allocates a native byte buffer, copies the bytecode into that buffer, packs a small local descriptor ({ptr,len,0}), then forwards descriptor + Java args object into pairip_vm_interpreter_core_tentative.

name: pairip_vm_interpreter_core_tentative
func_comment: Tentative name. Large VM-like execution core reached from the JNI execute bridge. Receives a bytecode-buffer descriptor plus Java args object, then enters a large dispatch loop / jumptable-driven state machine. Crash PC 0x5d75c lands inside this function on an indexed signed-byte read (ldrsb x2, [x16, x11]). Treat this as VM interpreter/dispatcher territory until disproved.
